other_exits: Close long when Lips cross below Teeth (signal reversal)
Close short when Lips cross above Teeth (signal reversal)

custom_logic_notes: Classic Williams Alligator strategy: Buy when Lips cross above Teeth and all three lines are properly aligned (Lips > Teeth > Jaw). Sell when Lips cross below Teeth and all three lines are properly aligned (Lips < Teeth < Jaw). Previous bar values ([1]) are used for crossover detection while current bar ([0]) values confirm alignment. SL and TP are specified in points and require digit-adjustment (multiply by 10) for 5-digit/3-digit brokers.
python_conversion_notes: Alligator is available as ta.trend.alligator or can be reconstructed from three smoothed MAs (SMMA of periods 13, 8, 5 with respective offsets of 8, 5, 3 bars). Entry uses crossover of Lips(5) and Teeth(8) with trend confirmation from Jaw(13) alignment. SL=31 pips, TP=69 pips - ensure point-to-pip conversion accounts for 5-digit brokers. New bar guard is essential to prevent repeated entries. Position check prevents stacking positions.
